name: Base.com
description: Base MCP connects Claude to your Base account for read-only access to your store data. Once connected via OAuth 2.1 (with your login and consent through Base's screen), Claude can check account details, look up orders, review product listings, and check inventory levels — all without leaving the conversation. The connector only reads data; it cannot create, modify, or delete anything in your Base account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Base.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Base.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.base.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Base.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Base.com in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Base.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Base.com is developed by Base.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
